end.summary:
Reyansh practised top, front and side views of solids.
Matched views to objects correctly in 4 attempts.
Answered that a cone looks like a circle from the top and a triangle from the side.
Answered that a cylinder looks like a rectangle from the side and a circle from the top.
Initially included unseen parts when describing a view; this was not corrected later in the lesson.
end.parentNote: Reyansh practised identifying how cones, cylinders, glasses and cubes look from different viewpoints. Using the visible face or outline helped them match all four object-view questions correctly. They mixed up a side view at first by describing the object they knew rather than only what could be seen; this was not corrected later. At home, ask them to look at a cup, box or ball from above and from the side, then draw only the visible outline.
